Definition: Mibsam, the name of an Ishmaelite and of an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Mibsam is named twice, in the generations of Ishmael: the firstborn Nebaioth, then Kedar, Adbeel and Mibsam. He is a son of Ishmael, remembered in the genealogy of the twelve princes.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Mibsam's place in Ishmael's line matters: he is one of the twelve princes God promised to Abraham's son, and the promise was kept to the letter.
